direction_change_deg.formula: Sum of signed shortest-arc differences between consecutive previous-observation directions on a 1 s grid; positive is clockwise
direction_change_deg.window: trailing 120 s ending at snapshot timestamp
direction_change_deg.denominator: one complete 120 s direction window; 121 grid points, at least 60 source timestamps, no source gap over 2 s

direction_rate_deg_per_min.label: Official wind direction trend
direction_rate_deg_per_min.formula: 60 × sum((second - mean second) × (unwrapped direction - mean unwrapped direction)) / sum((second - mean second)^2)
direction_rate_deg_per_min.window: trailing 120 s ending at snapshot timestamp
direction_rate_deg_per_min.denominator: sum of squared centered seconds on the 121-point valid 1 s direction grid
direction_rate_deg_per_min.source: independent raw official direction observations; shortest-arc unwrapping, previous measurement only, maximum age 2 s

speed_change_kt.label: Official wind speed change
speed_change_kt.formula: Fresh official speed at window end minus fresh official speed at window start, using previous observations
speed_change_kt.window: trailing 120 s ending at snapshot timestamp
speed_change_kt.denominator: one complete 120 s speed window; 121 grid points, at least 60 source timestamps, no source gap over 2 s
speed_change_kt.source: independent raw official speed observations converted from m/s to knots; previous measurement only, maximum age 2 s

projection_change_deg.label: Conditional five-minute direction projection
projection_change_deg.formula: 5 × OLS rate; requires |120 s direction change| >= 1°, |rate| >= 0.2°/min, |5 × rate| <= 30°, first/last 60 s OLS slopes with the same nonzero sign and each within max(0.25°/min, 0.5 × |rate|) of full-window rate, residual RMS <= max(1°, 0.2 × |direction change|), and every 1 s direction step <= 3°
projection_change_deg.window: next 300 s, conditional on the preceding 120 s trend holding
projection_change_deg.denominator: one unvalidated linear extrapolation; not a calibrated weather forecast or an event-arrival estimate
projection_change_deg.source: trailing official direction trend only; no future measurements or external weather inputs

direction_change_deg.label: Official wind direction change
direction_change_deg.formula: Sum of signed shortest-arc differences between consecutive previous-observation directions on a 1 s grid; positive is clockwise
direction_change_deg.window: trailing 120 s ending at snapshot timestamp
direction_change_deg.denominator: one complete 120 s direction window; 121 grid points, at least 60 source timestamps, no source gap over 2 s
direction_change_deg.source: independent raw official direction observations; previous measurement only, maximum age 2 s

direction_rate_deg_per_min.label: Official wind direction trend
direction_rate_deg_per_min.formula: 60 × sum((second - mean second) × (unwrapped direction - mean unwrapped direction)) / sum((second - mean second)^2)
direction_rate_deg_per_min.window: trailing 120 s ending at snapshot timestamp
direction_rate_deg_per_min.denominator: sum of squared centered seconds on the 121-point valid 1 s direction grid
direction_rate_deg_per_min.source: independent raw official direction observations; shortest-arc unwrapping, previous measurement only, maximum age 2 s

speed_change_kt.label: Official wind speed change
speed_change_kt.formula: Fresh official speed at window end minus fresh official speed at window start, using previous observations
speed_change_kt.window: trailing 120 s ending at snapshot timestamp
speed_change_kt.denominator: one complete 120 s speed window; 121 grid points, at least 60 source timestamps, no source gap over 2 s
speed_change_kt.source: independent raw official speed observations converted from m/s to knots; previous measurement only, maximum age 2 s

projection_change_deg.label: Conditional five-minute direction projection
projection_change_deg.formula: 5 × OLS rate; requires |120 s direction change| >= 1°, |rate| >= 0.2°/min, |5 × rate| <= 30°, first/last 60 s OLS slopes with the same nonzero sign and each within max(0.25°/min, 0.5 × |rate|) of full-window rate, residual RMS <= max(1°, 0.2 × |direction change|), and every 1 s direction step <= 3°
projection_change_deg.window: next 300 s, conditional on the preceding 120 s trend holding
projection_change_deg.denominator: one unvalidated linear extrapolation; not a calibrated weather forecast or an event-arrival estimate
projection_change_deg.source: trailing official direction trend only; no future measurements or external weather inputs
